data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word 'foir', meaning 'deer', and the suffix '-ey', meaning 'little'. In ancient Ireland, a warrior or hunter was considered a protector of the deer and the forest. The name Furey thus carries the symbolism of a little warrior or protector.
